flag-dannebrog-lyndanisse.description: A painted battle scene: a central mail-clad knight in a helmet stretches both arms up toward a red banner with a white cross, which flies high against a dark, stormy sky with light breaking through. Other armoured men with shields and swords surround him on a hillside, and a shield with a white cross on red sits in the lower right. No visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.

flag-first-union-flag.description: A painted scene of a wooden sailing ship's deck in a stormy sea under dark clouds. A blue flag with a red upright cross and white diagonal cross flies from a mast or bowsprit. Several men in dark doublets and wide-brimmed hats stand on deck, some looking up and one reaching toward the rigging. Ropes and rigging fill the right side. No visible text, no frame, and the painting runs edge to edge.

flag-grand-union-raised.description: A man in a black tricorn hat and dark coat with brass buttons stands on the snowy deck of a wooden sailing ship, gripping a dark, tattered cloth on a rope. Above him a striped red-and-white flag with a Union Jack in the upper corner flies from the mast. Behind are a stormy grey sky, masts and rigging, a second ship and a snowy harbour town. The scene is 18th-century maritime, with no visible text, border or frame.

flag-stars-stripes-adopted.description: A woman with her hair pinned up, in a cream blouse and dark bodice, leans over a wooden table in a dim room lit by two candles. She is spreading a large flag on the table: a dark blue canton with a ring of white stars, and red and white stripes running across the rest. Spools of thread, a sewing kit and a window glow are visible in the background. No visible text, frame or border.

flag-french-tricolour-adopted.description: A man in a bicorne hat and dark frock coat grips a tall staff bearing a flag of vertical blue, white and red bands, shouting amid a crowd of raised fists. The crowd wears red knit caps and some carry muskets with bayonets. The setting is a dim, columned hall with balconies and smoke, painted in an oil-painting style. There is a small roundel cockade on the hat and no visible letters or frame.

flag-italian-tricolore-first.description: Inside a vaulted stone hall with a gallery of onlookers, a tricolour banner (red, white and green vertical bands with a laurel-wreathed emblem) is unfurled from the balcony rail. Below, men in dark 18th-century coats and tricorn hats raise their arms and face the flag, with a speaker at a wooden lectern in the centre, and light falls through a high window.

flag-union-flag-st-patrick.description: A Union Flag with a red and white diagonal cross and blue field is flying from a tall wooden mast held by two men on a platform. Behind them is a stone building with a balustrade and chimneys under a stormy grey sky. A crowd in greatcoats, top hats and tricorn hats looks up at the flag. There is no visible text, signature or frame, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

flag-argentina-belgrano.description: An oil-style painting of a man in a navy military coat with gold epaulettes, a black bicorn hat and white breeches, raising a light blue and white striped flag on a tall pole beside a wide river, with a second man in brown clothing helping at the pole. On the left, soldiers in blue and white uniforms stand in a line with muskets, a mounted officer sits on a brown horse, and a black cannon sits in the foreground under a dramatic stormy sky. No visible text, no frame, and the painting runs edge to edge.

flag-greece-adopted.description: A painting of a group of men in white fustanella kilts and embroidered jackets on a rocky shore. The man on the left raises a blue-and-white striped flag with a white cross, and the others around him carry long muskets. Stormy sky, sea at left, no visible text or frame; it fills the canvas edge to edge.

flag-irish-tricolour-presented.description: A man in a dark frock coat and waistcoat stands on a black wrought-iron balcony of a red-brick Georgian-style building, holding a long pole with a green, white and orange vertical tricolour flag, one arm raised toward a crowd of men in top hats, caps and dark coats packed into a grey, overcast street. The painting is edge to edge, with no text, border or frame visible.

flag-japan-hinomaru-decreed.description: An oil-style painting of a dark-hulled steam and sail ship moored at a quay at dusk. A white flag with a red disc flies from a mast at the bow. Men in headbands and loose robes, and uniformed men in dark caps, handle thick ropes on the wooden dock, beside crates and barrels. A small junk-rigged boat sits on the left. The scene reads as mid-to-late 19th century. No visible text, frame or wounds.

flag-brazil-green-gold.description: A green-and-yellow flag with a blue globe and white band waves above a crowd in a dusky town square. A man in a dark military-style uniform and cap grips the pole while men in hats and shirtsleeves raise fists and hats around him. Rifles, torches, tiled roofs and a mountain sit under a stormy sky. No text or frame is visible.

flag-philippines-unfurled.description: A painted scene of a large wooden building with a carved balcony and lattice windows. A white-blue-red banner with a golden sun and three stars is unfurled from the balcony, with men in white shirts cheering from the windows. Below, a crowd of men in straw hats and white shirts raise their fists, and uniformed men with rifles stand at the front. There is no visible text, and the painting runs edge to edge.

flag-australia-first-flown.description: A dark blue flag with a Union Jack canton and white stars flies from a tall pole in a stormy, painterly sky. Below it, a large domed sandstone-coloured building is surrounded by a crowd of people in top hats, long coats and Edwardian dress, some with arms raised. The scene is an oil-painting style, with no visible text.

flag-thailand-tricolour-adopted.description: An oil-style night scene of uniformed men raising or lowering a red flag with a white elephant on a tall pole, while a tricolour flag (red, white, blue, white, red) flies from a second pole. A man in a dark dress uniform with a sash and sword gestures on the right, beside men in white formal dress. Gilded, tiered temple roofs and a spire stand behind, with parasols and onlookers on the left. There are no visible letters, no frame, and no blood. The painting runs edge to edge.

flag-germany-black-red-gold.description: A formal chamber with gilded galleries and a dome overhead. A huge flag of three horizontal bands (black, red, gold) hangs across the back wall. A man in a dark coat stands at the front with one arm raised, and rows of men in dark suits, some holding papers, fill the seats and balconies.

flag-soviet-hammer-sickle.description: A painterly, oil-style scene of a large red banner with a gold hammer and sickle and a red star, waving above a column of men in dark greatcoats and caps marching through falling snow. Behind them are red brick towers with white crenellations and spires, a striped onion dome at the far left, and a grey, stormy sky. No visible text, border or frame, and the painting runs edge to edge.

flag-india-tricolour-adopted.description: A painted flag of three horizontal bands (saffron-orange, white, green) with a dark spoked wheel at its centre waves at an angle, held up on a pole in front of a dense crowd of silhouetted people with raised arms. Sunset sky behind; domed and arched buildings sit on the left and a colonnaded building on the right, with small flags in the crowd. No visible text, frame or border.

flag-israel-adopted.description: An oil painting of a still life in a dark room: a wooden table with a window open at the back, a blue-and-white flag with a blue six-pointed star draped across it, a striped shawl hanging at the left edge, ink pots, and papers with faint scribbled lines.

flag-china-five-star-raised.description: A painted scene of a large red-and-gold flag with yellow stars flying from a tall pole in front of a red walled gate with a tiled, ornate roof. A dense crowd of dark-clothed people stands in the foreground under a moody, cloudy dusk sky. There are street lamps at the left and no visible text, letters, frame or border.

flag-ghana-raised.description: A crowd of dark-skinned people in wrapped, patterned cloth raises their arms at night under a dark sky, toward a tall silver flagpole flying a red, yellow and green flag with a black star. Warm lights glow through haze, in a painterly oil style. No visible text, no frame or border, nothing graphic.

flag-nepal-double-pennant.description: Main subject is a red flag with a blue border, a white crescent moon on the upper pennant and a white eight-pointed sun on the lower, flying from the peaked roof of a dark wooden pagoda-style temple. Behind it are snow-capped mountains under a stormy grey sky. Painterly oil style, with the scene filling the whole canvas edge to edge. No visible text, letters or frame.

flag-canada-maple-leaf.description: A snowy scene in a painterly style. A red, white and red flag with a red maple leaf flies on a tall pole at upper right, blowing against a grey sky. On the left stands a large Gothic stone building with a tall clock tower and a green spire, dusted with snow. In the foreground, a crowd of people in dark winter coats and hats is seen from behind, with uniformed guards in dark coats standing at the pole. Snow falls throughout. No visible text or frame.

flag-uae-raised.description: An oil-style painting at dusk. A flag with a red hoist block and green, white and black horizontal bands flies from a tall white pole on the right, against an orange and dark blue sky. On the left stand a low white modern villa with columns and palm trees, and beyond it a calm sea with a sunset glow.

flag-bangladesh-adopted.description: A green flag with an off-centre red disc flies from a tall bamboo pole on a stormy, grey-skied riverbank. A crowd of villagers in saris, lungis and loose shirts look up at it, and a river beyond them is packed with wooden boats with sails and passengers. Brick and tin-roofed houses and a thin smoke plume sit on the far bank, with palm and tree silhouettes in the haze. Oil-painting texture, no visible text or frame.

flag-zimbabwe-raised.description: A silhouetted figure climbs a flagpole at night, topped by a white-triangled flag with a red star and a gold bird, in green, yellow, red and black stripes. Below, a dense crowd of dark silhouettes raises fists and arms under stadium floodlights, with smoke or haze drifting and a small flag visible far to the right. The style is a painterly night scene with no visible text.

flag-russia-tricolour-returns.description: Night scene in an oil-paint style. A young man in a dark jacket stands on a heavy olive-green tank holding a large white, blue and red horizontal-striped flag aloft. Several other young people crowd the turret and hull, some raising fists. Behind them is a tall pale modernist government-style building with lit windows, with searchlight beams, smoke and a small fire in the background, and a crowd below. Dress is late-Soviet-era jeans, leather jackets and work jackets. No visible text, no frame, no gore.

flag-south-africa-new.description: A flag with a green, black and yellow Y-shaped hoist and red, white and blue arms flies from a tall pole against a dusk sky. Below, a long queue of dark-clothed people, several of them children, stands on dusty ground in front of tin-roofed shacks, with power lines and a setting sun behind them. The painting is edge to edge with no frame or text.

flag-kosovo-unveiled.description: Snowy dusk in a city street. A crowd seen from behind in dark winter coats and hats raises a large dark blue flag with six white stars and a gold map shape in the centre. Apartment blocks, street lamps and bare trees surround them, and a few people hold up phones with bright flashes.

flag-south-sudan-raised.description: The main subject is a tall grey flagpole with a black, red, green and white flag with a blue triangle and yellow star flying from its top. Below, a dense crowd of dark silhouetted people raises their arms, with small flags among them. The setting is a hazy golden sky with light rays, in an oil-painting style. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.
